# axm mcps new

Create a new MCP server

## When to use

Create a new MCP server

## Usage

```bash
axm mcps new [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description            |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ---------------------- |
| `name` | string | Yes      | Name of the MCP server |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                   |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `--description` | string  | No       | Description for the MCP server                |
| `--owner`       | string  | No       | Override the workspace owner (e.g., @acme)    |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Auto-accept confirmation prompts              |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Override constraints that would cause failure |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Display plan without applying                 |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Create a new MCP server manifest**

```bash
axm mcps new context
```

**Create under a specific owner**

```bash
axm mcps new context --owner @acme
```

**Preview the files that would be created**

```bash
axm mcps new context --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
